body:
Adds a **Walk** option to cardio logging — pace and duration, no intervals.

## A walk is a treadmill workout, not a new activity

It is done on the treadmill, so it shares the treadmill activity, color and history lane. It differs from the interval templates only in that its single `walk` interval (the type those templates already use) is entered per session instead of being fixed.

## The template document is the default

Mirrors how a strength exercise's default lives on the exercise definition. The walk is a real `cardio-template` (`steady-walk`, `steady: true`) created by migration 006, so:

- Selecting **Walk** prefills the saved pace and duration.
- Ticking **"This is the new default"** writes the entered values back to the template via the existing admin `PUT /api/cardio-templates/:templateId` — no new endpoint.
- The promotion runs *before* the session is logged and aborts the log if it fails, so the default and the log can never disagree. Same behavior as the strength flow.

Migration 006 is re-runnable and deliberately preserves whatever intervals the document already holds, so re-applying can never reset a default set from the app.

## Display

A logged treadmill session with one interval is a steady one: the detail view shows a **Speed** metric instead of a one-row Intervals list, and the summary line reads `3.4 mph` instead of `0 jog intervals, 32 min`.

## Verification

Run against the live database from the dev server:

- Dry-run: 1 pending migration, `create: 2`, safe to retry.
- Walk prefilled 3.2/30 from the template; logged 3.6/40 with the box ticked → template default became 3.6/40 and the next form load prefilled it.
- Logged 2.9/15 with the box unticked → default stayed 3.6/40.
- Test sessions and the hand-created template were deleted afterwards; migration 006 has since been applied for real, so the Walk template now exists in the database and the runner will skip it at deploy.
- Frontend lint and build pass; backend tests pass (7/7).
title: Log a steady walk as a treadmill workout
